messages:
Rosa: quick FYI  I spotted several docs examples that still use the old function_call config and a couple of broken example links. Can we split work into redirects first, snippet migrations second?

Devon: +1. I'll run linkcheck and open a tiny PR for redirects. Please paste the grep if you have it.

Rosa: grep output posted to issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1077. Hotspots: /docs/guides/tool-calling/, /docs/examples/python/, /docs/reference/structured-output/.

Hana: I can take Python snippet updates. Proposed canonical change (py):
```
# old
resp = client.chat.completions.create(..., function_call={"name": "get_user"})
# new
resp = client.chat.completions.create(..., tools=[get_user])
```
Also add a one-line note to show the JSON schema for tool args.

Devon: opened PR #5201 for redirects -> moves old pages to /docs/legacy-examples/ and adds redirects. CI linkcheck showed 6 failures; this PR addresses them.

CI-Bot: automated: linkcheck report attached for PR #5201. https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/reports/5201.

Rosa: great. After PR #5201 merges, let's do PR #5202 for snippets + migration note. Keep the migration note <= 3 lines in /docs/migration.md pointing to compact-envelope example and SDK snippet changes.

Hana: drafting PR #5202 now. I'll include py + ts before/after snippets and a short compatibility shim for older SDKs that don't accept tools=[...]. Example shim (py):
```
def shim(client, name):
  return client.wrap_tool(name)
```
Not actual API, just a one-liner suggestion for docs.

Devon: PR #5201 merged. Redirects live. Moving on to PR #5202.

Hana: PR #5202 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5202  contains updated snippets, compact-envelope example, and migration note. Requesting review from @Rosa.

Rosa: reviewed, left two tiny wording nits. Recommend adding a short sentence in structured-output page about avoiding top-level union arrays (parser brittle).

Hana: addressed nits and added the union-of-arrays guardrail. Pushed changes. Preview build: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/preview/5202

CI-Bot: automated: docs preview succeeded. No new broken links detected.

Rosa: LGTM. Merged PR #5202. Thanks everyone. If you see external blog posts referencing old slugs, send me the URLs and I'll add permanent redirects. :tada:
